description.mn: Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition: Хүйс харгалзахгүй хув үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: бергамот, ногоон ноот; зүрхний ноот: амтат гуа, чихэрлэг ноот, хан боргоцой, хув; суурь ноот: ваниль, заар, модлог ноот.
description.en: Amber Oud Gold Edition by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Amber Oud Gold Edition was launched in 2018. Top notes are Bergamot and Green Notes; middle notes are Melon, Sweet Notes, Pineapple and Amber; base notes are Vanilla, Musk and Woody Notes.
